Print each character of a string with its index.

Supplied answer
s = "Python"
for index, ch in enumerate(s):
    print(index, ch)
# without enumerate
for i in range(len(s)):
    print(i, s[i])
Note: enumerate() gives the index and the value together - cleaner than range(len(s)).
